templates.name: RFP Development
templates.description: Starter plan for RFP development / procurement support engagements.

roadmapStages.label: Initiation / Setup
roadmapStages.description: Confirm kickoff, governance, project controls, and workspace setup.

roadmapStages.label: Discovery / Intake
roadmapStages.description: Confirm stakeholders, roles, discovery coverage, and client context.

roadmapStages.label: Source Review / Research
roadmapStages.description: Collect and review source materials, prior work, and public context.

roadmapStages.label: Analysis / Requirements
roadmapStages.description: Develop, validate, and trace requirements and related analysis.

roadmapStages.label: Package Development
roadmapStages.description: Draft and refine solicitation package content, exhibits, and instructions.

roadmapStages.label: Review / Approval
roadmapStages.description: Resolve review comments, readiness checks, and approval decisions.

roadmapStages.label: Evaluation / Selection Support
roadmapStages.description: Support scoring, vendor questions, demonstrations, selection, and negotiation work.

roadmapStages.label: Closeout / Handoff
roadmapStages.description: Complete closeout, sign-off, final artifacts, and handoff expectations.

projectPlanItems.title: Confirm project kickoff and governance structure
projectPlanItems.notes: Confirm kickoff participants, decision roles, communication cadence, and project controls.

projectPlanItems.title: Project controls document
projectPlanItems.notes: Document working assumptions, project controls, review cadence, and artifact ownership.

projectPlanItems.title: Client provides background documentation
projectPlanItems.notes: Collect prior procurement material, current requirements, contracts, workplans, and relevant source documents.

projectPlanItems.title: Stakeholder list and roles confirmed
projectPlanItems.notes: Confirm stakeholder groups, subject matter experts, reviewers, and decision-makers.

projectPlanItems.title: Business requirements questionnaire
projectPlanItems.notes: Prepare structured questions to gather functional, operational, technical, and procurement context.

projectPlanItems.title: Business requirements document
projectPlanItems.notes: Summarize business needs, constraints, assumptions, and procurement requirements.

projectPlanItems.title: Requirements validation completed
projectPlanItems.notes: Confirm requirements are complete enough for solicitation development and client review.

projectPlanItems.title: Draft CMS / system requirements
projectPlanItems.notes: Draft system requirements for client review and refinement.

projectPlanItems.title: Requirements traceability matrix
projectPlanItems.notes: Map requirements to source inputs, decision rationale, and procurement sections where useful.

projectPlanItems.title: Draft RFP solicitation document
projectPlanItems.notes: Prepare the draft solicitation structure and reusable RFP sections for client review.

projectPlanItems.title: Confirm RFP structure and required exhibits
projectPlanItems.notes: Confirm solicitation sections, required exhibits, submission instructions, and attachment strategy.

projectPlanItems.title: Final RFP document
projectPlanItems.notes: Finalize the RFP document after client review and accepted revisions.

projectPlanItems.title: Evaluation criteria and scoring methodology
projectPlanItems.notes: Draft scoring criteria, weighting approach, and evaluation instructions for client review.

projectPlanItems.title: Confirm vendor demonstration / interview approach
projectPlanItems.notes: Decide whether demonstrations, interviews, scenarios, or oral presentations are part of evaluation.

projectPlanItems.title: Vendor questions / clarification process ready
projectPlanItems.notes: Confirm intake, tracking, review, and approval process for vendor questions and clarifications.

projectPlanItems.title: Draft written responses to vendor questions
projectPlanItems.notes: Draft response language for client review based on approved requirements and procurement intent.

projectPlanItems.title: Initial negotiation matrix
projectPlanItems.notes: Prepare a matrix of negotiation topics, requirements, risks, and proposed positions.

projectPlanItems.title: Procurement terms or legal boilerplate are unresolved
projectPlanItems.notes: Track unresolved terms, procurement language, or legal review items that could affect final package readiness.

projectPlanItems.title: Requirements are not testable or vendor-answerable
projectPlanItems.notes: Review requirements for clarity, response format, acceptance criteria, and vendor-answerable wording.

projectPlanItems.title: Project closeout meeting completed
projectPlanItems.notes: Hold closeout meeting to confirm final artifacts, open issues, and handoff expectations.

projectPlanItems.title: Project closure report
projectPlanItems.notes: Summarize work completed, artifacts delivered, unresolved assumptions, and recommended next steps.

projectPlanItems.title: Stakeholder sign-off received
projectPlanItems.notes: Confirm final stakeholder acceptance or approval of the agreed project artifacts.

templates.name: Evaluation / Assessment
templates.description: Starter plan for justice system evaluation, operational assessment, technology assessment, or modernization roadmap engagements.

roadmapStages.label: Initiation / Setup
roadmapStages.description: Confirm scope, objectives, project setup, and kickoff expectations.

roadmapStages.label: Documentation / Source Review
roadmapStages.description: Collect, catalog, and review background documentation and source materials.

roadmapStages.label: Stakeholder Discovery
roadmapStages.description: Plan and conduct stakeholder engagement and SME interviews.

roadmapStages.label: Current-State Analysis
roadmapStages.description: Document current-state workflows, operational pain points, and process dependencies.

roadmapStages.label: Systems / Integration Analysis
roadmapStages.description: Assess systems, integrations, data flows, and platform capabilities.

roadmapStages.label: Gap / Risk / Recommendations
roadmapStages.description: Identify gaps, risks, constraints, recommendations, and roadmap priorities.

roadmapStages.label: Draft Review / Approval
roadmapStages.description: Submit draft report and facilitate client review.

roadmapStages.label: Final Delivery / Handoff
roadmapStages.description: Finalize the report, presentation materials, handoff, and follow-up items.

projectPlanItems.title: Confirm evaluation scope and objectives
projectPlanItems.notes: Confirm purpose, assessment boundaries, expected outputs, review cadence, and success criteria.

projectPlanItems.title: Client confirms designated contact and SME roster
projectPlanItems.notes: Identify client contact, subject matter experts, reviewers, and decision-makers.

projectPlanItems.title: Project plan and schedule
projectPlanItems.notes: Prepare a practical plan and schedule for assessment activities, reviews, and deliverables.

projectPlanItems.title: Client provides background documentation
projectPlanItems.notes: Collect policies, process documents, current-state materials, reports, inventories, and supporting artifacts.

projectPlanItems.title: Documentation catalog
projectPlanItems.notes: Create a catalog of reviewed documents, source types, gaps, and follow-up needs.

projectPlanItems.title: Documentation review summary
projectPlanItems.notes: Summarize key findings, constraints, assumptions, and information gaps from documentation review.

projectPlanItems.title: Legislative / policy compliance matrix, if applicable
projectPlanItems.notes: Map relevant policy or compliance considerations when they affect findings or recommendations.

projectPlanItems.title: Stakeholder interview guides
projectPlanItems.notes: Prepare interview guides tailored to stakeholder roles and assessment objectives.

projectPlanItems.title: SME interviews scheduled
projectPlanItems.notes: Confirm interview schedule, attendees, logistics, and topics.

projectPlanItems.title: SME interviews completed
projectPlanItems.notes: Confirm interviews are complete or identify remaining stakeholder coverage gaps.

projectPlanItems.title: Current-state workflow documentation
projectPlanItems.notes: Document current-state workflows, operational steps, pain points, and decision points.

projectPlanItems.title: Systems inventory and overview
projectPlanItems.notes: Summarize systems, platforms, modules, users, ownership, and high-level usage context.

projectPlanItems.title: Integration and data flow mapping
projectPlanItems.notes: Map key integrations, data exchanges, dependencies, and information flow constraints.

projectPlanItems.title: Vendor / platform capability assessment, if applicable
projectPlanItems.notes: Assess known platform capabilities and limitations where they are relevant to the engagement.

projectPlanItems.title: Gap analysis summary
projectPlanItems.notes: Summarize gaps between current state, needs, constraints, and desired future state.

projectPlanItems.title: Operational risk assessment
projectPlanItems.notes: Document operational risks, dependencies, assumptions, and priority concerns.

projectPlanItems.title: Requirements recommendations
projectPlanItems.notes: Draft requirements or recommendation themes based on the assessment findings.

projectPlanItems.title: Prioritized modernization roadmap
projectPlanItems.notes: Prioritize recommendations by value, urgency, dependency, and feasibility.

projectPlanItems.title: Confirm recommendation priorities
projectPlanItems.notes: Confirm which recommendations should be emphasized, sequenced, or deferred.

projectPlanItems.title: Draft final report
projectPlanItems.notes: Prepare draft assessment report for client review and working session discussion.

projectPlanItems.title: Draft review working session completed
projectPlanItems.notes: Review draft findings, recommendations, and revisions with the client.

projectPlanItems.title: Final report
projectPlanItems.notes: Finalize report after client review and approved revisions.

projectPlanItems.title: Final presentation materials
projectPlanItems.notes: Prepare concise presentation materials for final briefing or closeout.

projectPlanItems.title: Final presentation completed
projectPlanItems.notes: Confirm final presentation is complete and any closeout follow-up items are captured.
